about: Paid model usage for the OCR proof (DC's 50-document plan, step 2: AI reads the Baidu OCR text, checkers confirm). Synthetic documents only. Authorised: about US$1.00 for chat-side test spend (coordinator, 14 Nov 2026). One entry per run_id; never edit or remove an entry.

runs.source: As reported by the coordinator; run made in thread 'Prove PaddleOCR reads 50 files completely' on branch claude/project-thread-lg8je3 (figure-check.ts, ocr50_00 pages 1-6, text layer). Not re-measured here.

runs.note: One tiny call to prove the new DEARPOLICY_ANTHROPIC_KEY works. Rounded up.
figure-check.ts on Baidu parsed-pages.json of ocr50_00 pages 17-20. Guards made no calls: the worst case of their first batch was above the US$0.25 guard cap, so they stopped before spending.

pipeline.ts on 12 listed pages (pages-batch1.txt): reader 1 + 3 page-image checkers (Sonnet 5.5, Haiku 4.5, Opus 5.5). Stopped on the cap after 10 pages (ocr50_09 p16 and ocr50_10 p52 not run). Spend from API token counts.

runs.source: proof thread, pipeline.ts on ocr50_03 p2 and ocr50_01 p51 (step2/diag-notread)

runs.note: pipeline.ts on 16 pages (pages-batch2.txt), reader 1 + one page-image checker (Sonnet 5.5). All 16 pages read; not stopped. Spend from API token counts.
